name: agentic-sdlc
description: Deterministic, gated SDLC loop for full-stack JavaScript projects. Track-driven, Playwright-validated, security-reviewed, PR-completed.

interface.shortDescription: Run a gated ticket-to-PR development loop
interface.longDescription: Agentic SDLC guides Codex through a deterministic development cycle: intake, implementation, validation, review, PR creation, review comments, and revalidation. It uses the existing track-file, schema, command, agent, and template documentation in this plugin as the source of truth.
